rounds.text: The valuation of Arihant Capital Markets Ltd is fundamentally unsupported by its intrinsic cash flows, as a discounted cash flow model values the company at just Rs 39 per share against a market price of Rs 80.5, leaving a severe negative margin of safety of -104.6% [E45, E46]. This disconnect is further underscored by alarming cash flow deterioration, with operating cash flow crashing to Rs -105 Cr and free cash flow plunging to Rs -109 Cr in March 2026, leading to a catastrophic cash conversion ratio of -3.18x [E34, E35, E36]. Operational efficiency is simultaneously under pressure, evidenced by a ten-percentage-point contraction in operating margins over the trailing twelve months to 35% compared to three years prior [E30], compounded by high debtor days sitting at an inefficient 176 days [E60]. Concurrently, balance sheet leverage has spiked aggressively as borrowings nearly tripled to Rs 225 Cr in March 2026 from Rs 82 Cr a year earlier [E39], while institutional investors continue to divest amid negative money flow and declining promoter stakes [E41, E44, E68]. Conceded: [E73].
